# Dating Method

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](gmeow-DatingMethod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DatingMethod>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

The method used to derive a temporal measurement — radiocarbon, dendrochronology, thermoluminescence, etc. A value, never a subclass. Specialises [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md) for the temporal dating domain.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md), [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](gmeow-DatingMethod.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md), [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
